summary: Project a real wavevector in the x-z plane from a nonnegative magnitude and angle, or calculate magnitude from paired components already expressed in inverse metres.

identity.relation: Real x-z plane wavevector declaration to perpendicular and parallel components and magnitude
identity.direction: k and theta_rad -> kx, kz, k; or paired kx and kz -> kx, kz, k
identity.definition: Polar: kx = k sin(theta_rad), kz = k cos(theta_rad). Cartesian: k = hypot(kx, kz). The two input modes are exclusive.
identity.model: Euclidean wavevector geometry, without a dispersion or resonance model
identity.geometry: Background field along z; real wavevector in the x-z plane
identity.coordinates: Right-handed Cartesian x-z components with z parallel to the background field
identity.boundary: Magnitude is nonnegative; zero magnitude keeps the supplied polar angle, whereas Cartesian mode returns no angle.
assumptions: Inputs have already been converted to consistent inverse-metre units.
The operation neither rotates coordinates nor handles a y component.

inputs.name: k_grid
inputs.description: Wavevector magnitude sweep in polar mode.
inputs.constraints: Nonempty, one-dimensional and nonnegative; exclusive with component grids.

inputs.name: theta_rad
inputs.description: Propagation angle from +z toward +x; ignored in Cartesian mode to preserve the incoming PDRF branch behavior.
inputs.constraints: Defaults to zero in polar mode.

inputs.name: kx_grid
inputs.description: Perpendicular component sweep in Cartesian mode.
inputs.constraints: Requires a same-length kz_grid; exclusive with k_grid.

inputs.name: kz_grid
inputs.description: Parallel component sweep in Cartesian mode.
inputs.constraints: Requires a same-length kx_grid; exclusive with k_grid.

outputs.name: theta_rad
outputs.description: Input angle in polar mode or null in Cartesian mode.

preconditions: Caller has already converted all wave numbers to 1/m.
All arrays are finite real vectors and paired component vectors have equal length.
supported: Single-angle polar sweeps and paired Cartesian component sweeps in the x-z plane.
excluded: PDRK scan selector, logarithmic controls, par state updates and derived angle output.
Complex wavevectors, y components and coordinate rotations.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for missing or mixed modes, negative/nonfinite polar magnitude, nonfinite angle, invalid component shape, or nonfinite computed Cartesian magnitude.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NumPy conversion errors propagate when input cannot be converted to a real array.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; there is no iteration.
failure_semantics.partial_results: None; validation completes before a result dictionary is returned.

provenance.lineage_summary: Candidate from PDRF planar projection, compared directly with the overlapping PDRK wavevector scan; both source packages remain independently traceable.
source_kinds: frozen D1 operator documents and implementations

example.description: Project a 3-4-5 Cartesian wavevector after caller-side SI conversion.
example.code:
from scirel.geometry import project_planar_wavevector
result = project_planar_wavevector(kx_grid=[3.0], kz_grid=[4.0])
assert result['k'][0] == 5.0
example.expected: kx=[3], kz=[4], k=[5] in 1/m, with theta_rad=None.

scope: PDRK overlap after explicit positive-cwp and degree-to-radian mapping.
Negative magnitude, zero-wavevector angle, scan-state and large-component numerical distinctions.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Seven isolated comparison tests establish the stated bounded mapping and differences; they do not prove complete PDRK equivalence or independent physical correctness.
known_limitations: PDRF's normalized input-card wave number has no approved conversion to 1/m in this proposal.
Cartesian magnitude uses hypot and intentionally differs from PDRF's overflow-prone square-and-sum at large finite components.
PDRK scan-state semantics require a separate candidate.
Expert approval and distribution licensing are pending.
